headline: Goa Unveils AI Policy 2026
summary: Goa has officially introduced its AI Policy 2026 alongside a state-level hackathon and a new Konkani language model. Chief Minister Pramod Sawant hailed the initiative as turning vision into action.

headline: Rafale Marine Trials Begin in Goa
summary: The Indian Navy has commenced Rafale-Marine take-off and landing trials in Goa. These tests are being conducted to prepare the aircraft for operations on the INS Vikrant.

headline: Goa Govt Wants Shivaji Statue to Remain at Site
summary: The Goa government has defended its acquisition of the MPA statue site in the High Court. It stated that it wants the Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj statue to remain at its existing location because he is dear to Goans.

headline: ST Groups Issue Ultimatum on Quotas
summary: Tribal communities in Goa have given the government a five-day deadline to implement ST political reservation. They warned of launching a major campaign if the quota process is not completed before the 2027 polls.

headline: Bomb Threat Delays IndiGo Flight
summary: An IndiGo flight from Chennai to Goa suffered a five-hour delay after receiving a bomb threat. Passengers were safely deboarded while security checks were conducted.

headline: Pope Appoints Goan-Origin Priest
summary: Pope Francis has appointed a priest of Goan origin as a member of a theological body. The appointment has been widely celebrated in the region.

headline: Mandovi River Contaminated with Faecal Coliform
summary: A recent study has warned that Goa's Mandovi river contains high levels of faecal coliform. The findings highlight significant pollution concerns in the water body.

headline: Goa Hotels See Post-Festive Rush
summary: Post-festive travel demand has caused a major spike in Goa hotel rates, with luxury villas priced at Rs 5 lakh and premium rooms exceeding Rs 45,000. The surge highlights strong domestic tourism interest.

headline: Goa to Add 40 New Ambulances
summary: Health Minister Vishwajit Rane announced that Goa will commission 40 new ambulances within a month. The addition aims to bolster emergency medical services across the state.

headline: FIR Registered Against CJP Protesters
summary: Goa Police registered an FIR against around 300 CJP protesters. The action follows anti-Hindutva slogans raised during a rally in Panaji.

headline: Man Murdered in Canacona
summary: A man was murdered in Canacona, triggering a tense situation in the area. Reports indicate the victim had previously reported receiving threats.

headline: Transplant Athlete Wins Four Gold Medals
summary: Goan transplant athlete Umesh has won four gold medals in Hong Kong. His stellar performance has brought immense pride to the state.

headline: Traditional Tarangas Worshipped During Dussehra
summary: Villages across Goa celebrated Dussehra by worshipping Tarangas, which serve as sacred insignias of local deities. The traditional rituals saw enthusiastic participation from residents.

headline: Comba ROB and Roadworks Cleared
summary: The Centre has granted approval for the Comba Rail Over Bridge (ROB). Additionally, two other major roadworks have been cleared to improve regional connectivity.

headline: Warm Weather Abroad Slows Charter Flights
summary: Unseasonably warm weather in foreign countries has delayed international charter tourist inflows to Goa. Many travelers are currently opting for last-minute bookings.

headline: GSUDA to Audit Property Tax Survey
summary: The Goa State Urban Development Agency (GSUDA) is set to appoint an independent agency to audit a recent property tax survey. The move ensures transparency in local urban administration.

headline: Pedestrian Deaths Fall in Goa
summary: Traffic data reveals that pedestrian fatalities in Goa decreased by 33%. However, authorities noted a concerning rise in cyclist deaths over the same period.

headline: Congress Threatens Court Action Over Electoral Roll
summary: The Congress party has given the Chief Electoral Officer a 10-day deadline to scrap the SIR electoral roll. They have threatened legal action if their demands are unmet.

headline: FC Goa Secures First Win in Asia
summary: FC Goa kept their Asian Champions League campaign alive by registering their maiden victory in the tournament. The hard-fought win boosted the team's standing.

headline: Goa Farmers Face Marigold Sales Slump
summary: Despite a successful harvest and increased marigold output in Goa, local farmers are struggling with a sales slump. Market demand has failed to match the higher production volume.

headline: Low Farmland Insurance Uptake in Goa
summary: Data reveals that only 0.69% of farmland in Goa has been insured over the past decade. Agriculture stakeholders attribute this to low awareness and distinct local farming challenges.

headline: Foundation Stone Laid for Tuem Ravindra Bhavan
summary: A foundation stone was laid for a new Rs 113-crore Ravindra Bhavan in Tuem. The cultural facility aims to boost arts and community events in the region.

headline: Agriculture Department Warns of Water Shortage
summary: Anticipating potential water shortages, the Goa agriculture department plans to issue an advisory. Farmers will be urged to shift to short-duration crops to conserve water.

headline: Tillari Shutdown to Delay Water Supply
summary: A scheduled shutdown of the Tillari canal project will delay water supply plans for Calangute. Local authorities are managing alternative arrangements for residents.

headline: Traffic Diversions Announced for Bambolim
summary: Goa traffic police have announced temporary diversions in Bambolim for the installation of a foot overbridge. Commuters have been advised to take alternate routes to avoid congestion.
